text: Excited to be working with MIXI in Japan as we continue to grow our partnership.

Today, we're announcing a strategic partnership with MIXI, one of Japan's largest gaming, sports and entertainment companies. MIXI will be deploying Runway across their organization, and we'll work together to explore emerging applications for world models across gaming, animation and interactive experiences.

Learn more at the link below.

Got to hang with the @runwayml folks during their film festival week, and pull back the curtain in today's early days ☀️

As a movie buff, I was both so thrilled to be invited in, and prepared to have complex feelings about it. 

What I found was a very rare culture - wisdom for AI startups looking to build something with a beating heart, a clear haven for artists, a team rallying to take on a wide world beyond video.
